name: com.nitrosend/nitrosend
title: Nitrosend
description: AI-native email marketing: campaigns, automation flows, contacts and transactional email over MCP.

environmentVariables.name: NITROSEND_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Nitrosend API key for stdio bridge usage (starts with nskey_live_). Required unless NITROSEND_BEARER_TOKEN is set.

environmentVariables.name: NITROSEND_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: OAuth bearer token for the stdio bridge. Use instead of NITROSEND_API_KEY.

environmentVariables.name: NITROSEND_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional MCP endpoint override (defaults to https://api.nitrosend.com/mcp)

environmentVariables.name: NITROSEND_BRAND_SID
environmentVariables.description: Optional fixed-brand override. When set, the bridge sends X-Brand-SID with each MCP request.
